versions.content: BSW Behavior Variation Points In a similar way, variation points underneath BswInternalBehavior allow to declare variants in the aggrega- tion of BswModuleEntity -s, BswEvent s and further elements. Likewise, several references and aggregations owned by BswModuleEntity are vari- ation points. There is Variation point in the aggregation of local data for calibration and measurement and of ExclusiveArea by the base class InternalBehavior too .
